messages.subject: Ledgerly interview invitation: Senior Backend Engineer
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for your time on the recruiter call. We'd like to invite you to interview for the Senior Backend Engineer role at Ledgerly.

Your virtual interview is on Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT over Zoom and has two parts:
- 60 min coding (we use CoderPad)
- 60 min system design

Job description: https://jobs.ledgerly.com/senior-backend-engineer

Best,
Priya Shah
Recruiting, Ledgerly
